questions.question: Amit is ﬁve years older than Vaibhav at present. After four years the ratio of their ages will be 5 ∶ 4. What is Amit's age (in years) at present?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Let Vaibhav’s age = a and Amit’s age = 5 + a

(Amit's age after 4 years)/(Vaibhav's age after 4 years) = 5/4

⇒ (5 + a + 4)/(a + 4) = 5/4

⇒ 20 + 4a + 16 = 5a + 20

⇒ 5a – 4a = 16

⇒ a = 16

∴ Amit’s age = 5 + a = 5 + 16 = 21

questions.question: If the ∠ABC and ∠ACB of triangle ABC is 80° and 60° respectively. If the Incenter of the triangle is at point ‘I’ then calculate angle BIC.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ABC = 80° and ∠ACB = 60° 

I is the incenter of the triangle

**Formula used:**

If a ΔABC, I is the incentre of the triangle,

then ∠BIC = 90 + 1/2 × ∠A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d01d6c4e4e24aca68d53fe98810bec79c44de7ecfc854e9cb9b26e97a7ccc63.png] 

**Calculation:**

∠ABC + ∠ACB + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ 80° + 60° + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° – 140° = 40°

Now, ∠BIC = 90° + (∠BAC)/2 = 90° + (40)/2 = 90° + 20°

**∴ ∠BIC = 110°**

questions.question: The incomes of S and T are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their expenditures are in the ratio 1 : 1. If S saves Rs. 4000 and T saves Rs. 22000, then what will be the income (in Rs.) of S?
questions.solution:
Let Income of S and T are 3a and 4a respectively and the expenditure of both S and T is b

Saving of S = Income of S – Expenditure of S

⇒ 4000 = 3a – b ----(1)

Saving of T = Income of T – Expenditure of T

⇒ 22000 = 4a – b ----(2)

Solving eq.(2) – eq.(1).

⇒ 22000 – 4000 = 4a – 3a – b + b

⇒ 18000 = a

∴ Income of S = 3a = 3 × 18000 = 54000

questions.question: X and Y started a business by investing Rs .171000 and Rs. 243000 respectively. If X’s share in the proﬁt earned at the end of year is Rs. 3800, then what will be the total proﬁt (in Rs) earned by them together?
questions.solution:
Capital Ratio of X and Y = 171000 : 243000 = 19 : 27

Profit earned by X = 19 units = 3800

⇒ 1 unit = 200

∴ Total profit = 19 + 27 = 46 units = 46 × 200 = 9200

questions.question: The average expenditure of Raman for 5 days is Rs. 130. If his expenditure for the ﬁrst 4 days is Rs. 100, Rs. 125, Rs. 85, and Rs. 160 respectively, then what is his expenditure (in Rs) of the 5th day?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

(1)The average expenditure of Raman for 5 days is Rs. 130

(2) If his expenditure for the ﬁrst 4 days is Rs. 100, Rs. 125, Rs. 85, and Rs. 160 respectively,

**Formula used:-**

(1) Average = (Sum of Observations) ÷ (Total Numbers of Observations)

**Calculation:-**

Total expenditure of 5 days = 130 × 5 = 650

Total expenditure of first 4 days = 100 + 125 + 85 + 160 = 470

∴ Expenditure of 5th day = 650 – 470 = 180 

**∴ The required an
swer is __180__**

Two pipes P and Q can ﬁll an empty tank in 25 hours and 20 hours respectively. Pipe R alone can empty the completely ﬁlled tank in 50 hours. Firstly both the pipes P and Q are opened and after 8 hours pipe R is also opened. What will be the total time (in hours) taken to completely ﬁll the tank?
questions.solution:
Time taken by pipe P to fill the tank = 25 hours

Time taken by pipe Q to fill the tank = 20 hours

Time taken by pipe R to empty the tank = 50 hours

Total capacity of tank = Lcm of (25, 20 and 50) = 100 units

Efficiency of pipe P = 100/25 = 4 units/hour

Efficiency of pipe Q = 100/20 = 5 units/hour

Efficiency of pipe Q = – 100/50 = – 2 units/hour

Efficiency of pipe P and Q together = 5 + 4 = 9 units/hour

Efficiency of pipe P, Q and R together = 5 + 4 – 2 = 7 units/hour

Tank filled in 8 hours = 9 × 8 = 72 units

Remaining capacity = 100 – 72 = 28 units

Time taken to fill remaining 28 units = 28/7 = 4 hours

∴ Total time taken to fill the tank = 8 + 4 = 12 h

questions.question: The perimeter of a square is 22 cm. Find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of a square = 22 cm 

**Concept used:**

Area of a square = side²

Perimeter of a square = 4 × side 

**Calculations:**

Let the side of the square be 'a'

Perimeter of a square = 22 cm

⇒ 4a = 22

⇒ a = 5.5 cm

Area of square = a² = (5.5)² = 30.25 cm²

**∴ Area of square is 30.25 cm²**.

questions.question: If the circumference of a circle is 88 cm, then what must be its area (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
Circumference of circle = 2πr

⇒ 88 = 2 × 22/7 × r

⇒ r = 2 × 7 = 14 cm

∴ Area of the circle = πr² = 22/7 × 14 × 14 = 616 cm

questions.question: Find the total surface area (in cm²) of a right circular cylinder of diameter 7 cm and height 6 cm.
questions.solution:
Total Surface area = 2πr (h + r) = 2 × 22/7 × 7/2 × (6 + 7/2) = 2 × 11 × 19/2

∴ Total Surface area = 11 × 19 = 209 cm²
